questions.question:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one that is closest in meaning to the given word.

Arcane
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Sibylline**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arcane"** means something that is understood by few; mysterious or secret. (गूढ़)

 
 
• **Example: **The professor's lectures were so **arcane **that only a few students could understand them.
 
 
 
• **"Sibylline" **refers to something that is prophetic and mysterious, often related to oracles. (भविष्यवाणी करनेवाला)
 
 
• **Example: **Her **sibylline **predictions about the future events left everyone in awe.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'arcane' **is closest to **'sibylline'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sibylline**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gaucherie **(अकुशलता): Awkward or unsophisticated ways.

 
 
• **Example:** His **gaucherie **at the dinner table was noticeable to everyone.
 
 
 
• **Propulsive **(प्रेरक): Having the quality of driving or pushing forward.
 
 
• **Example: **The **propulsive **force of the rocket was immense.
 
 
 
• **Acerbic** (कटु): Sharp and forthright, especially in manner or style.
 
 
• **Example:** His **acerbic **comments during the meeting were not appreciated.

questions.question:
Choose the word nearest in meaning to the word given below :

Arduous
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "strenuous"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the above question we have to choose the word nearest in meaning to the word "Arduous".
 
• Let's understand the meaning of the given words with examples.
 
• **Arduous:**__ This adjective is used to describe a task or activity that is difficult, demanding, and requires a lot of effort or energy. It often implies that something is physically or mentally challenging(कठिन).
 __
 
• *For example, *"Climbing Mount Everest is an arduous task that requires months of training and preparation."
 
 
 
• **Tiresome:**__ This adjective is used to describe something that is boring, monotonous, or exhausting. It often implies that something is tedious and makes one feel fatigued(थकाने वाला).
 __
 
• *For example, *"The long meeting was tiresome and I couldn't focus on what was being discussed."
 
 
 
• **Strenuous:__** This adjective is used to describe an activity or task that requires a lot of physical or mental effort. It often implies that something is demanding and challenging(ज़ोरदार).
 __
 
• *For example*, "The hike was strenuous and it took a lot out of me."
 
 
 
• **Smooth: **__This adjective is used to describe something that is easy, effortless, or without any difficulties. It often implies that something is flowing or flowing well without any interruptions(निर्बाध).
 __
 
• *For example*, "The presentation went smoothly and I received positive feedback from the audience."
 
 
 
• **Effortless: **__This adjective is used to describe something that is easy, without any difficulties and does not require a lot of effort. It often implies that something is done with great ease(सरल).
 
 
• *For example*, "He solved the math problem with effortless ease and impressed his classmates."
 
 
 
• **Thus, as per the above explanation the meaning nearest to the meaning "Arduous" is "Strenuous"**

__Directions__: Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response accordingly.

For some time after the minister's resignation, the __stench__ of scandal hung over the government.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**whiff**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stench** - a strong, unpleasant smell. (बदबू - एक मजबूत, अप्रिय गंध। उदाहरण: "जब हम गली में चले तो कचरे की बदबू हवा में भर गई।")

 
 
• **Example**: *"The **stench** of garbage filled the air as we walked down the alley."*
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words**__

__
 
• **Mellow** - having a soft and soothing tone; relaxed and unhurried. (मधुर - एक नरम और सुखदायक स्वर होना; आराम । उदाहरण: "मधुर संगीत ने मुझे एक लंबे दिन के बाद आराम करने में मदद की।") 

 
 
• **Example**: *"The **mellow** music helped me to unwind after a long day."*
 
 
 
• **Dawn** - the first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise. (भोर - सूर्योदय से पहले आकाश में प्रकाश की पहली उपस्थिति। उदाहरण: "मैं भोर के सुंदर गुलाबी और नारंगी रंग देखने के लिए जल्दी उठा।")
 
 
• **Example**:* "I woke up early to see the beautiful pink and orange hues of **dawn**."*
 
 
 
• **Trot** - a gait of a horse where both legs on one side move forward at the same time. (दुलकी चाल - घोड़े की चाल जिसमें एक ओर के दोनों पैर एक साथ आगे बढ़ते हैं। उदाहरण: "जब हम ग्रामीण इलाकों से गुज़रे तो घोड़े की चाल स्थिर थी।")
 
 
• **Example**: *"The horse's **trot** was smooth and steady as we rode through the countryside."*
 
 
 
• A "**whiff**" is a slight trace or hint of an odor or scent. It can also refer to a brief gust of air that carries a smell. (एक "व्हिफ" गंध या सुगंध का एक मामूली निशान या संकेत है। यह हवा के एक संक्षिप्त झोंके को भी संदर्भित कर सकता है जिसमें गंध होती है।)
 
 
• **Example**: *If someone walks past you and you catch a faint smell of their perfume or cologne, you might say that you caught a "**whiff**" of their scent.* (उदाहरण के लिए, यदि कोई आपके पास से गुज़रता है और आपको उसके परफ्यूम या कोलोन की हल्की गंध आती है, तो आप कह सकते हैं कि आपने उसकी गंध की "सूँघ" पकड़ी।)
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words,** *the correct answer is **Option 4, i.e., whiff.***

questions.question:
Direction: Select the synonym of the word "sponsor" that is mentioned in bold:

I met Mr. Kapoor last month. He agreed to be my __**sponsor**__ so that I could join the club.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'patron.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us see the meaning of Sponsor:

 
 
• Sponsor: a person or an organization that helps to pay for a special sports event, etc. (usually so that it can advertise its products). (विशेष खेल स्‍पर्धा आदि के लिए विज्ञापन-प्रदर्शन की सुविधा के साथ आर्थिक सहयोग करने वाला व्‍यक्ति या संस्‍था; प्रायोजक (व्‍यक्ति या संस्‍था)।)
 
 
 
• Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:
 
 
• Patron: a person who gives financial or other support to a person, organization, or cause. (एक व्यक्ति जो किसी व्यक्ति, संगठन या कारण को वित्तीय या अन्य सहायता देता है।)
 
• Admirer: a person who has particular regard for someone or something. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी या किसी चीज़ के लिए विशेष सम्मान रखता हो।)
 
• Critique: a detailed analysis and assessment of something, especially a literary, philosophical, or political theory. (किसी चीज़ का विस्तृत विश्लेषण और मूल्यांकन, विशेष रूप से एक साहित्यिक, दार्शनिक या राजनीतिक सिद्धांत।)
 
• Entrepreneur: a person who sets up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit. (एक व्यक्ति जो लाभ की आशा में वित्तीय जोखिम उठाकर व्यवसाय या व्यवसाय स्थापित करता है।)
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the given words, we can say that the synonym of the word **"sponsor"** that is mentioned in bold is **"patron."**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

questions.solution:

• **"Commitment"** refers to the state or quality of being dedicated to a cause or activity. (प्रतिबद्धता)
 
 
• **Example:** His commitment to his job is evident in his long working hours.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the nearest meaning to 'dedication' is 'commitment'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **commitment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Apathy** (उदासीनता): Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.
 
 
• **Example:** The apathy of the students was concerning to the teacher.
 
 
 
• **Negligence** (लापरवाही): Failure to take proper care in doing something.
 
 
• **Example:** His negligence led to a serious accident.
